notes: Maintenance release: CR audit FX-legal-moves (#983). Rules behavior change: the legal-action list and applyAction now agree, so every move the engine accepts is listed and nothing listed is refused. Interrupts are no longer hidden by the paid ability window's priority: Net Shield while net damage is pending and Decoy on the Corp's turn (CR 9.2.9c, 9.9.4d). Every rez is offered at apply's own cost, discounts included (Asteroid Belt, CR 1.16.2a). Apply now refuses what the list refused: actions in the paid ability window after an action (CR 5.6.2), trashing a card with no trash cost (7.1.5a), declining a free steal (7.1.6), abilities of cards in R&D or removed from the game (1.8.3a, 9.1.7), 'play only if' plays such as Petty Cash (9.3.3b), plain prevention of damage only interrupts may prevent, and a second use of an identity's once-per-turn ability. The list no longer offers installs apply refuses (Research Station, ZATO City Grid, the identity's remote-server limit). New debug check src/debug/legalityAgreement.ts runs in the seeded playouts. Pins cards v1.147.25.
